title: School Knowledge Quiz
description: How well do you know our campus? Answers are hidden in the virtual tour.

questions.question: Which location is the first stop of the virtual tour?
questions.explanation: The tour starts at the Main Entrance, where the path leads to the Main Building.

questions.question: Which building has the clock tower?
questions.explanation: The clock tower crowns the Main Building.

questions.question: Where are microscopes and chemistry glassware used?
questions.explanation: The Science Laboratory has microscopes, glassware and safety equipment.

questions.question: Where is the annual sports day held?
questions.explanation: Sports day and the inter-house championship take place on the playground.

questions.question: Who looks after the school garden?
questions.explanation: The eco club cares for the flower beds, vegetable patch and pond.

questions.question: What do smart boards in classrooms help with?
questions.explanation: Smart boards support interactive lessons, videos and quizzes.
